description:
DeFi Balance Booster

An ETHGlobal hackathon project using
  - Gnosis Pay
  - Yearn
  - Ajna


We created two main use cases

 - Savings account
     - Mimic rebalancing from saving to checking
     - Saving account yield comes from yearn

 - Debt account
     - Mimic credit card
     - yearn vault used as collateral to get a line of credit
how_its_made:
Open source part:
The smart contracts are written in solidity/vyper using forge. You can run the tests easily using the MAKE file.

The process is the following:
 - User deploys a contract
 - Contract can be called in a permissionless way by keepers to rebalance the user card position

All contracts were deployed to gnosis-chain and verified in gnosisscan.

Website and keepers bot are not public code.
